name: Winamax
verdict: French online poker and sports-betting operator based in Paris, owned by its founders and shareholders Alexandre Roos and Christophe Schaming. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: gambling sponsor (online poker / sports betting) — owner chain checked as required: founders Roos and Schaming per Winamax's own page, both listed as dirigeants in the registry; a 2010 EUR 12m Idinvest round is the only outside money found and no state stake appears. French press and Wikipedia note a 2022 money-laundering investigation (mise en examen of the company) and a 2021 Conseil d'État ruling on ANJ's online-gaming decisions — financial/commercial matters, not sourced human-rights abuses, so no record claim and no tier above none is proposed. No state links in the chain.
